description: Header file defining the cctz::time_zone class and related functions for time zone conversions, lookups, and formatting within the Abseil C++ library.

classes.name: time_zone
classes.description: Represents a time zone with methods for lookup, transition, and formatting.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the time zone.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns civil and offset information for a given absolute time.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns civil and offset information for a given civil time.

methods.name: next_transition
methods.description: Finds the next offset transition after a given time.

methods.name: prev_transition
methods.description: Finds the previous offset transition before a given time.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns version info of the time zone data.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a description of the time zone.
